status: frozen after deriving the pressure-column comparison and before executable verification; no holdout is opened
purpose: Test whether a standard non-derivative symmetry-restoring scalar can change the integrated Solar pressure charge while retaining an order-unity cluster Weyl response. This is the potential-screen successor required by v17P.

solar_model_s.provenance: Model S radius, pressure, density, sound-speed, adiabatic-index, and temperature profile from Christensen-Dalsgaard et al. 1996

clash_spent_profiles.provenance: Spent CLASH baryonic acceleration profiles; used only for a conservative pressure-column comparison

authorization.allowed_outcome: retain or retire the standard quartic pressure-symmetron completion and apply the three-formulation Solar/cluster stopping rule

candidate_action.action_class: Canonical quartic symmetron with a reciprocal TeVeS-like non-derivative physical metric
candidate_action.potential: V(X)=-mu^2 X^2/2+lambda X^4/4, with v=mu/sqrt(lambda) and vacuum range L=1/(sqrt(2)mu)
candidate_action.critical_pressure_density: rho_crit=mu^2 M^2; rho_p>rho_crit restores X=0 and removes the local matter coupling
candidate_action.one_metric_response: The same q(X) sources the scalar through pressure and changes the Weyl metric; there is no analyst-supplied lens multiplier.
candidate_action.health_scope: The canonical scalar kinetic term and bounded quartic potential avoid the v17N derivative-metric Hessian. This gate tests source selectivity, not cosmology, domain walls, or the full coupled aether constraint system.

pressure_column_theorem.screening_coordinate: For a spherical source, A_obj is proportional to rho_p R^2/(rho_crit L^2), equivalently Pi_p G M/(R c^2) up to universal factors.
pressure_column_theorem.screen_factor: Let S(A) be the scalar-charge fraction, monotone nonincreasing with A.
pressure_column_theorem.cluster_normalization: An order-unity cluster Weyl field requires alpha^2 Pi_cluster S_cluster>=1.
pressure_column_theorem.solar_consequence: If A_cluster>=A_sun then S_cluster<=S_sun and abs(gamma-1)_sun=2 alpha^2 Pi_sun S_sun>=2 Pi_sun/Pi_cluster.
pressure_column_theorem.decision: If every spent cluster pressure-column indicator exceeds the Model S Solar indicator and the resulting lower bound exceeds Cassini, the standard pressure symmetron cannot provide the required selectivity for any universal coupling.

optimistic_profile_control.critical_density_choice: Set rho_crit equal to the largest inferred enclosed-mean CLASH pressure density. This is lower than a true central/local maximum and therefore maximizes Solar screening while treating the cluster as unscreened.
optimistic_profile_control.solar_boundary: Solve the exact normalized quartic interior equation with regular center and the linear vacuum Yukawa matching condition at one Solar radius.

decision_rule: Retain the candidate only if both the pressure-column theorem and the optimistic Model S boundary-value control pass Cassini with the same cluster-normalized coupling.

If cluster pressure columns are no smaller than the Solar column, increasing symmetry restoration cannot improve the Solar-to-cluster response ratio; retire the standard pressure symmetron rather than fitting its threshold.

V17G unscreened propagation, v17P conserved kinetic-flux screening, and v17Q symmetry-restoring charge screening are three materially distinct completions tested against the same one-coupling cluster-strength plus Solar-slip gate.
If v17Q fails that gate, reset the direct pressure-only reciprocal metric mechanism. Do not add a fourth pressure screen.

formula_inventory.equations: Symmetron V=-mu^2 X^2/2+lambda X^4/4; TeVeS-like disformal metric q=-X^2/(2M^2); V_eff=[-mu^2+rho_p/M^2]X^2/2+lambda X^4/4; A_obj proportional Pi_p GM/(Rc^2); abs(gamma-1)_sun>=2Pi_sun/Pi_cluster
